verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs show batch-style read operations: querying a collection with a list of query texts at once, and `.get`/`.query` combining `where_document` and metadata filters to act on many matching items. Copy-on-write forking duplicates an entire collection in one request. However, nothing in the pack documents bulk writes such as batch add, upsert, update or delete-by-filter, so bulk operation is only shown on the read side. Missing for 10: documented batch add/upsert/update/delete across many items, delete-by-filter, bulk operations via the CLI or MCP server, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
